text: FOL ::: ∀x (Musician(x) ∧ Versatile(x) → (∃y∃z (Plays(x, y) ∧ Plays(x, z) ∧ Instrument(y) ∧ Instrument(z) ∧ y ≠ z ∧ (y = Piano ∨ y = Guitar) ∧ (z = Piano ∨ z = Guitar)) ∧ ∃w∃v (PerformsInStyle(x, w) ∧ PerformsInStyle(x, v) ∧ Style(w) ∧ Style(v) ∧ w ≠ v ∧ (w = Jazz ∨ w = Rock) ∧ (v = Jazz ∨ v = Rock))))
